title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update: B‑52H, A2A Comanche & PMDG 737‑900 Take Over the Sky!
description:
This Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 marketplace update for February 14, 2026, is a massive one for MSFS 2024 pilots! This MSFS Marketplace Update features highly anticipated MSFS new aircraft, including the B-52H GKS strategic bomber, the legendary A2A Comanche 250, and the PMDG 737-900. If you are looking for the best Flight Simulator 2024 addons, this week also delivers a huge variety of MSFS new liveries like the PMDG liveries and Captain Sim liveries packs.

In today's flight simulation news, we’re covering this MSFS PC update in detail, from the B-52H MSFS release to the premium A2A Comanche MSFS experience and the latest PMDG 737 update.

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 GKS: B-52H (Iconic long-range USAF strategic bomber)
🛫 A2A Simulations Inc.: Comanche 250 (Premium GA aircraft with deep realism)
🛫 PMDG Simulations: PMDG 737-900 (High-fidelity airliner for serious sim pilots)

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🎨 Captain Sim: 777-200/200ER PW (Packs 27 & 33) & AC-130J Livery Pack 1
🎨 PMDG Simulations: PMDG 737-900 Americas & Asia-Europe Livery Packs
🎨 JED Studio: WWII D-Days C-47 Liveries

If you enjoyed this Marketplace breakdown, don’t forget to hit like, subscribe for more MSFS 2024 news, and drop a comment telling me which aircraft you’re grabbing this week!

✈️ See you in the skies!
